title: DamageValue - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Applies damage to the specified Actor Value on this Object Reference. Syntax: Function DamageValue(ActorValue akAV, float afDamage) native Parameters: - akAV: The Actor Value to damage. Actor Value List - afDamage: The amount of damage to apply to the actor value. Return Value: None. Examples: ActorValue property HealthAV ; Damage the player's health 10 points Game.GetPlayer().DamageValue(HealthAV, 10)
ActorValue property HealthAV ; Damage Bob's health 5 points Actor Bob = Bob_Alias.GetReference() as Actor Bob.DamageValue(HealthAV, 5) See Also: - Actor Value List - ObjectReference Script - GetValue - ObjectReference - GetBaseValue - ObjectReference - ModValue - ObjectReference - RestoreValue - ObjectReference - SetValue - ObjectReference
